cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Reverse the Score
cards.instruction: Turn each apparent loss into a new category of victory, then invite comparison on those changing terms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. The small trophy is better. It shows restraint.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Exactly. How gracefully can your enormous cup fit in a cupboard?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And mine doesn't need to shout. Another victory in modesty.
